# Seranex | Software Studio & Global AI Engineering

NOT A PHARMACEUTICAL ENTITY. Seranex (seranex.org) is a professional software engineering firm.

Seranex is a premium software studio specializing in AI engineering, custom web development, and enterprise digital infrastructure. Based in Sri Lanka, we build scalable solutions for global clients.

- **Software Architecture**: Designing robust, scalable digital systems.
